name: Greek Yogurt

pros.title: fermented-food angle adds extra value
pros.explanation: Plain Greek yogurt can bring live-culture context that plain milk does not.

pros.title: thick texture helps satiety
pros.explanation: The strained texture makes it more filling than many softer dairy options.

pros.title: easy unsweetened protein base
pros.explanation: It works in meals without needing added sugar.

cons.title: dairy tolerance is not universal
cons.explanation: Lactose sensitivity or dairy avoidance can make it a poor fit for some people.

cons.title: sweetened versions change the profile fast
cons.explanation: The plain record is strong, but common flavoured tubs can add a lot of sugar.

cons.title: saturated fat varies by style
cons.explanation: Whole-milk versions carry more saturated fat than low-fat or nonfat versions.
